description: Agent Negotiation: submit one agreed deal and its settlement: the parties, the agreed price, currency, method (stablecoin, card, bank transfer, escrow, invoice, cash or other), network, payment and delivery due and the order of delivery and payment (payment first, delivery first, both at once, escrow or milestones), the settlement’s amount, currency, method, network, timing, order and escrow holder, and each settlement step with the party that does it. The signed report reads the settlement against the agreement field by field and step by step, and names a different amount, currency, method, network or order, payment later than due, no stated order and every step no party owns, then no network for a stablecoin payment, escrow with no holder, no due dates and steps after a step the list lacks, with the fix for each. Expected settlements against transfers are wever_settlement-reconciliation-check, a payment instruction is wever_payment-instruction-check and a settlement claim against chain evidence is wever_settlement-proof-check. Verdict cannot_settle, settlement_gaps, settlement_unverified or settles_as_written. POST /api/negotiation-settlement-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-negotiation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-negotiation/.
